title: Wire ?history=1 on GET /api/panes/:pane/screen
action: Building on cell 1's already-updated src/web/screen.rs (compile-fix only there) and cell 1's PaneScroller::read_history (returns ScreenRead{text, revision}): extend GET /api/panes/:pane/screen (src/web/screen.rs::read_screen) with an optional query param `history` (e.g. `?history=1`): absent -> unchanged behavior from cell 1 (ReadSource::Recent, lines:80, no PaneScroller involvement); present -> call PaneScroller::read_history and build ScreenBody{text: result.text, revision: result.revision} directly from its returned ScreenRead, same as the existing non-history path already does. No new endpoint, no new response type. D11's spec updates are NOT part of this cell — handled by the bee-scribing chain step after execution, per plan.md's Approach section.
